Italy's Amalfi Coast is nuzzled between the towns of Amalfi and Positano. Praiano – a lovely town perched on the rocky cliffs of this coast – offers vistas of unparalleled beauty and a leisurely pace of life.

Guests may stay at luxury villas offering the grandest ocean views, expansive living and dining spaces, gardens, terraces, swimming pools, hot tubs and more. Praiano offers guests a more laid-back, local feel with its many attractions, churches, amazing nightlife, and exclusive access to its less busy beach, Marina di Praia.

Check the link in bio and get a glance of Praiano dreams.

Credits to: @italy
